$comment: Synthetic vectors for ask-plan/1 (docs/03-technical/ask-llm.md section 2.4). plans[].plan is the model's reply; plans[].sent is the text sent to the backend (placeholders already inserted); plans[].expect.outcome 'accept' means steps 1-5 pass (a template, if any, is judged by the templates section); 'fallback' means PL-FALLBACK with counted=false and the failing step and reason code. Step 1 = backend/contracts/ask-plan-v1.schema.json. All data is synthetic.

normalisation.rule: norm(s) = foldKey(s) from packages/zaghlol_parsing/lib/normalize/text_normalizer.dart: Arabic-Indic and extended digits to ASCII, U+066B to '.', U+066C to ',', odd spaces to one space (runs collapsed, trimmed), invisible and direction marks removed, tatweel and harakat removed, alef variants to alef, alef maksura to yeh, teh marbuta to heh, ASCII lowercase. Step 3: norm(mention) is an ordinal substring of norm(sent). Step 4 numbers: in norm(sent), a number is [0-9]+(,[0-9]{3})*(.[0-9]+)? with commas removed; equality is decimal equality (500 = 500.00). Step 2/ref: the ref string occurs verbatim (no folding) in the sent text.

numberWords.note: Minimum bundled list; the phone may bundle more. Words are matched after foldKey, as whole words.

registryAliases.note: A small slice of the bundled institution registry, enough for the plain-name vectors (step 2).

templateBlanks.note: Blanks a template may use per plan (step 6). Plans not listed never use a model template (BR-LLM-04).

templates.note: Arabic letters are at least 70 percent of the letters outside the blanks
e + U+0301 composes to U+00E9 in NFC. .NET hosts with invariant globalization (this repo) cannot normalise: use a real NFC implementation

t.text: صرفت {amount} on dining this month for you

rules.LENGTH: text is 1..200 UTF-16 code units and one line (no LF, CR, U+0085, U+2028, U+2029)
rules.LANG: t.lang is 'ar' or 'en' and equals the request lang
rules.PLAN_NOT_ALLOWED: plan has an entry in templateBlanks (PL-INVEST, PL-SUGGEST, PL-REFUSE, PL-FALLBACK never do)
rules.DIGIT: no character of category Nd (any script), so no digit of any script
rules.PLACEHOLDER: no U+27E6 or U+27E7 (checked before DIGIT, because a placeholder contains a digit)
rules.BAD_BLANK: after removing every {name} with name in the plan's blanks, no '{' or '}' remains, and every {name} in the text is one of the plan's blanks
rules.DUPLICATE_BLANK: each allowed blank occurs at most once
rules.LINK: no '://', no 'www.', and no letter-dot-letters shape (regex \p{L}\.\p{L}{2})
rules.CONTROL: no Cc character and none of U+061C, U+200B..U+200F, U+2060, U+202A..U+202E, U+2066..U+2069, U+FEFF
rules.EMOJI: at most one scalar in U+1F000..U+1FAFF, U+2600..U+27BF, U+2B50, U+2B55
rules.SCRIPT: ar: after removing blanks, letters (category L*) are non-empty and Arabic-script letters (U+0600..U+06FF, U+0750..U+077F, U+08A0..U+08FF, U+FB50..U+FDFF, U+FE70..U+FEFF) are at least 70 percent of them; en: no Arabic-script letter

templateRules.outcome: the first failing rule in 'order' gives the reason; a failure drops t only (plan kept, app template used)
